test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The marked price of an article is ₹150. The shopkeeper offers a discount of 20% on the purchase of the article. Thereby, he makes a profit of 25%. The cost price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of an article = ₹150

Discount = 20%

Profit = 25%

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

80% of 150 = 125% of C.P

⇒ 0.8 × 150 = 1.25 × C.P

⇒ 120 = 1.25 C.P

⇒ C.P = (120)/(1.25) = ₹ 96

**∴ The cost price of the article is ₹ 96.**
